user.title: Add Wyze Scale
user.description: Select a discovered scale. If none are listed, make sure the scale is powered and in range, then step on it to prompt an advertisement.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found: No Wyze scales found. Make sure the scale is powered and in range, then step on it and try again.

data.advertisement_trigger: Sync automatically when the scale wakes up
data.fallback_interval: Also sync every this many seconds (0 = disabled)
data.display_unit: Unit shown on the scale display (none = leave unchanged)

user.title: Add a scale user
user.description: Create a user profile on the scale. The scale uses this for body-composition measurements and matches each weigh-in to the closest profile.

data_description.weight_kg: Roughly the person's weight; used only to match weigh-ins to the right user.

reconfigure.title: Edit scale user
reconfigure.description: Change this user's profile. Updates are pushed to the scale on the next sync.
